summary: Clearwater County, ID lookout: 1915 crow's nest, 1927 platform tower, Clearwater Timber Protective Association; three of four pages list it abandoned, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned with no date; no source says the platform was taken down or describes what remains
facts.location: about 26 miles northeast of Orofino, Clearwater County, Idaho

staffing.status: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it does not yet have records of the lookout's staffing

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up

events.note: Crow's nest, per the Forest Lookouts page (credited to Kresek) and firelookout.com
Platform tower, per the same two pages; neither says whether it replaced the crow's nest

evidence.supports: page does not yet have records of staffing
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

corrections.why: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association all list the lookout as Abandoned; none says the platform was taken down

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone corrected to abandoned per the sources. The 1915 and 1927 dates come from Kresek through the Forest Lookouts page; firelookout.com repeats them, and no independent record was found in one web search. The Forest Service Clearwater National Forest lookout list does not name Silver Butte, so it is not cited. No source describes the site today.
